extension.summary: Shows the Red Light Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
extension.description: Opens Red Light's Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy show and episode details, so its style can be checked without playing an episode. The buttons only close the popup, and Back or Escape also closes it. Needs Red Light to be installed.
extension.news: 1.0.0: First release. Shows Red Light's Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
